text:
The worst attidude we ever had! Strongly rasisist! They treat african american and white people very nice, and yell to Chinese. Forced us to give tips while not imply it on the door and did not tell us that before we eat. And we found out they steal two dollars from our credit card after several days!!!!This is against law! Never go to this junky restuarant any more!
遇见过最差的态度！种族歧视！对待白人和黑人非常礼貌，对待中国人根本不理睬，从来不加水，餐具也不分发，服务员就在边上聊天嘻嘻哈哈，对待客人就是大喊大叫。强制给小费，如果不给就不让人走。但是在大门口根本没有标明强制，这是违反法律的！而且我们离开后还发现从我们卡里偷了两块钱！这样没有诚信的种族歧视的餐厅，以后我们绝对不会再来！！！

I stopped into the Tahyo back in late 2018 on a recommendation from my boss. I'm a local and work in the area and spend a lot of my time eating and drinking through the French Quarter. I was aware of the place's affiliation with the rescue, even though I'm a dog person and pitbull lover and owner, my ongoing patronage of the establishment has nothing to do with my personal interests. The food, the staff and the ambiance of the place keep me coming back. From the first time I went in there, I felt among friends and in a comfortable setting where I could eat and drink as long as I pleased. There's several staff members who I've dealt with, but Grayson behind the bar always seems to be running the show. I come in after work, not wanting to talk to people a lot of the time and he's always quick with my drinks and knows to let me drink my high life in peace. I keep coming back thanks to his efficiency and the overall friendliness of just about everyone I've dealt with in there. No matter what affiliation the tavern has, its rings of a true locals NOLA spot. And that mac and cheese is off the chain. Highly recommend to everyone I come across in my daily work. Thanks Grayson and everyone else for keeping this place up and running its just what the city needs in the area.
Ordered a white pizza tonight on seamless/grubhub. The Pizza taste excellent. Great texture and flavors. The crust was also delicious. Looking forward to ordering other dishes off the menu.

Cute mom and pop restaurant that serves incredibly flavorful food! Service was incredible and the owners were very kind. We ordered the falafel, the beef shawarma bowl and the baklava and devoured everything within minutes.
These people don't know how to make a plain latte.  It was a sugary mess.  It was way overpriced for the poor quality of drink it was.

First time ever to Santa Barbara and our uber driver recommended, INSTITUTION. Order drinks got food everything was nice but after a trip to the restroom accidentally forgetting my mask at the table led to an employee becoming aggressive violent and ultimately kick us out of the restaurant. So unnecessary random and just completely ridiculous. If you go wear your mask 100% of the time.

Just ordered delivery through grub hub. Food is absolutely perfect. Pizza is still hot, and delicious. Mozzarella sticks are cooked perfect. I also ordered some garlic Parmesan chicken fingers. I don't know what they did to make this my new favorite appetizer.
This place has not only never let me down, but it has amazed me everytime I eat there.  Try the Jalepeno Cilantro Hummus...  It is tge beat Hummus I've ever had.  Hands down!

Great food and service. My wife's chicken Alfredo and my lobster Alfredo were both excellent.  There were many pieces of perfectly grilled chicken in her dinner.  My dinner had a full lobster tail.  The Alfredo sauce in both was creamy and flavorful.  We wouldn't hesitate to order either dinner again.  Our server was knowledgeable and attentive. We're both looking forward to going back

My favorite place to take friends visiting New Orleans. Always incredible service, food is phenomenal. Today I ordered food and on the way to pick up was in a fender bender. Called to let them know I'd be late and they made sure that when I arrived a few hours late that I had food made fresh for me to pick up. Can't speak highly enough about the folks who run this restaurant. As I write this my
Mouth is watering for their lemongrass wings. Some of the best Vietnamese in Nola.

We REALLY wanted to like this place, after trying 3 or 4 others in the area since we moved here 8 months ago, and not finding anything decent yet. My friend's Pork Fried Rice was extremely salty. I told her not to eat it and gave her my eggroll. My General Tsao chicken was like some that I've had at a Chinese buffet, after its been sitting out several hours. Good flavor but chewy, some pieces impossible to chew. I asked the server on our way out what did she recommend that was fresh and good? She said "Everything fresh , you order it, we cook it right away".  No doubt. After it's been sitting in the fridge a week. Guess we'll keep looking. Or maybe, forget asian and just stick with the wonderful Greek restaurants they have around here.
Super. Amazing gem. Found by accident and I'll definitely be back. Buffalo chicken cheesesteak was hotter than expected but a great choice. I'll bring the family for sure.

Some of the best eggplant Parmesan I've ever had (mine included).  The sandwiches are delicious with lots of good choices.  They have some pantry foods for sale as well as a very well stocked freezer for food you can take and bake.  And very tasty canolli.  We actually ate the canolli within minutes of arriving home.  Soooo good.  

This spot is off the beaten path and well worth trying.
The best dinner we have had in New Orleans!! The service and the staff recommendations where excellent , we will be back on next trip!!

Went here last night for my birthday dinner and it was a horrible experience.   My lobster tail which was cooked TWICE was awful both times.  Luckily my dinner was free because of it being my birthday because no one cared to do anything about it.  Portions were super small compared to other times.   I am/was highly disappointed.   Especially when I brought 10 other people with me.   Embarrassing.    No activity from our chef at all.   Don't think we will be back anytime soon.  I hope someone will reach out from management because the whole night was messed up and it made me very upset.

It's just okay.... nothing special. 

Customer Service 
Taste of Food 
Atmosphere 

We ordered a Italian beef and hamburger meals along with a bowl of chili. We waited for awhile for our meals. Based on other reviews, I was expected. :( The fries were cold but the rest of foods were okay.  It was better than Berger king but I don't think I will visit again.

Yes, yes, yes! Came to visit this weekend and wow - I am completely blown away. The service was upstanding. Food was tasty, fresh, and appealing to look at. The atmosphere is gorgeous and is the perfect spot for a lunch date. Will definitely be back once they officially open later this week! Good luck y'all!

This was my first experience with Ethiopian food. I enjoyed most of the food. It was definitely an experience eating and sharing a meal with no utensils, but I enjoyed it. I was a part of a big group of which there was a reservation in place. I was one of the first to arrive, and they were not prepared (I was about 10 minutes early). We actually had to help them set up for the group. There seemed to be only a couple of people serving, and I'm not sure how they were able to keep up with our large group in addition to other parties-but they seemed to handle it. The decor in the restaurant is unimpressive-but they make up for it with the tasty flavors of the food. The vegetable samosa was my absolute favorite even though they were quite expensive compared to everything else on the menu.

I'm always looking for a not-the-norm place for lunch and Family Mediterranean had been on my list of places to go for awhile. 
After finally parking at the right business and being seated, I decided to go with one of their lunch specials. I hadn't eaten liver in years, but decided to order it anyway. Diced, seasoned well, and pan fried, this dish served to me would change the minds of most people that really dislike liver... the two sides that I had were an eggplant app and a chopped cucumber dish.   
This place is located off the Main Street through town. Actually pulling into the right driveway can be challenging. But I think that the lunch that I was served will have me coming back to try the full menu...

I wanted for this place to be yummy, I really did. 

Little about me, I never tasted bad coffee in my life, meaning when everybody around me EVER complained about coffee taste, I smelled the cup and took a sip and ALWAYS thought, "no, coffee is ok".
I'm the guy who will see 2 day old pizza in refrigerator and say "yay, yummy pizza"....

So now you know about low standards of my taste buds, let me tell you about liquid this, not so yummy place calls "coffee". 

It's Muck water with coffee flavoring!!! 

Come one, Yummy, clean your coffee machine from mold and replace water filter!!!! That's NOT asking for much!!!!!

Side note, bacon was good BUT cook does not know or care what is "over medium eggs" are. You will get what ever he fills like it. Runny eggs seems his specialty. 

I will give you a try in few months to see if you improved.
I love Guppy's for it's outside seating, and non seafood offerings for landlubbers like me. Something for everyone. Makes for a pleasant Sunday lunch or brunch!

So glad we gave Mango a try for Covid Curbside Pickup.  The same good flavors I remember, in value-priced lunch-sized portions (see photos).  Flawless web order, hand-delivered to John H.'s SUV by a friendly masked staff member.  Thanks Mango, our meal was delicious!

Not bad!  An urban vibe. Slow service. Cool atmosphere. Decent food. Not wow but good!  

There is an electronic pad at the table to order drinks if you want. 

Out came some chips and salsa. They asked if you want guacamole for extra charge. 

I ordered Enchiladas de Pollo Chicken, corn tortilla, mole colorado, avocado, Monterey Jack. It was good. Spices were all over because the first bite was very spicy and I handle spice very well.  The rest was ok. The beans were fantastic. Nice flavor. Rice was cooked nice too. There were three enchiladas. So all in all quite a bit of food!  However for $17 I hope I did get enough. Took some home.

Lindo Mexico II has some tasty food! We ordered takeout for a birthday celebration and everyone loved their orders. I tried the Pollo Azteca, which is a chicken plate with sautéd veggies, rice and beans. It was tasty! I'd order it again. 

Since we got takeout, I can't speak to the dine in experience. But I'd give them a try in person in the future!

Been there a few times and was never impressed. Close to home. Never again will I eat there. Small portions, bad service and dirty. Had a hair on top of my pork sandwich last time. Serve food on a piece of paper on top of a food tray. Cafeteria food. Expensive also. No great experience !

If you're looking for a good burger at a pretty good price you can take out or done in this is perfect! This place was close to our hotel and we'd never eaten at one before even tho we'd heard about them a lot. (and actually we mistook it for anyoher popular burger chain at first, but realized it wasn't the same). I looked online and it said to download the app for a discount.. Try that and it might still be available. It was super easy and fast. We eneed up ordering it again the following day.  I ordered a double stack and a stack shack.. Which is a single burger with a fried portabello mushroom with munster and cheddar inside.. Yes. Yes please! Unfortunately  they messed it up and forgot the shoom part on one of the burgers.. It was about a 4 buck difference. But what we got was still amazing. I'm a stickler for good customer service so I called 
 the next day and they made it right. I will go back again. Def order here! You'll love these burgers.

Killer breakfast burrito. Tortillas are
Grilled and crispy. Good coffee and friendly service at the window. Super fast also.

15 years ago I visited this restaurant with a client. We were ignored by the staff and the lasagna came out frozen. I was convinced to give then another try today, after 15 years, and once again we were ignored by the staff, our food was incorrectly prepared, the staff was rude when we pointed out the mistake. Now I remember why I never visit this restaurant. They weren't interested in keeping my business 15 years ago, and it still holds true today

It is hard to find a restaurant in Reno that isn't afraid to use spice the way it is meant to be used. With that said, this place goes right for the taste buds. I ordered a lamb shawarma with zhug and habanero sauce.  WOW!  The meat was done to perfection and the other ingredients were fresh and flavorful. Hard to find place. We walked around the block once and finally found the entrance. I will go back for sure.

Friendly staff and amazing food. We love ordering their egg sandwiches, always so good! They also carry grand cafe laquila coffee which saves us a trip from going to the city. This place is immaculate and we're so happy to have them so close by.

My friends and I went to BB's on a Sunday night. We are from New Jersey and did a little research to find this place. The music was great ! The Love Band performed and the band was on point ! The drinks were good and reasonably priced. The only reason it didn't received five stars is because of the food. Two of us ordered the NOLA, and the other a catfish basket.  The food was decent but nothing to rush back to. I would definitely return for drinks and music, just eat before I come.

i went in today around 3:30 to order take out, it wasn't busy at all. I ordered a simple turkey hoagie, only turkey, mayo, and pickels. (weird i know, lol) and a side of fries with cheeze wiz. it took about 15-20 minutes, no big deal. i got home opened everything and my whole order was wrong. they didn't give me cheese wiz for my fries, and my hoagie had everything on it. i went back and told them even more specifically what i wanted. A turkey hoagie, only turkey, mayo, and pickles. no cheese no veggies, no oil, ect. And a side of cheese wiz for my fries. that times i waited 30-40 minutes, and i get home, the hoagie is correctly done, but they put mozzarella cheese on my fries and no cheese wiz. I don't know if there it was a miscommunication with the host, or the chefs. but if i'm paying money for my order, which i think is a simple order it should be done right. i wasted almost an hour and a half of my day because of this. i've never had a problem with this order before.

I came here for the first time the other day and I gotta say compared to other places in the Tampa area this place is pretty good. When I walked in there was a very energetic girl behind the counter, super nice and fun, she gave really good descriptions and recommendations for things to try. I myself am West Indian and when every there's a new Jamaican place I gotta try the jerk chicken rice and peas with the steam cabbage, if they can't do that right then on to the next. So, here I ordered the jerk chicken rice and peas as well as the pepper shrimp and a pineapple and mango drink. The food was good, the seasoning on the chicken was great. The jerk sauce I was given was not what I expected, sweet? I don't know I like spice not sweet so that wasn't my favorite. The drink had ginger in it, if you don't like ginger then don't order it because it was heavy on the ginger. All in all I would definitely go back but I would change up my order a bit. Maybe try the curry on the next go.
We recently went to Tankie's and it was delicious! Great food, and the waitress was very nice. I fell in love when I saw the thick-cut bacon appetizer. We will be going back!

The service was fine. The menu seemed good in theory, but the pizza was mediocre. I think I probably would have enjoyed a pizza from Dominos more. The menu sounds amazing and there are a lot of different options, but my crust was burnt and not very flavorful. The sauce was also pretty bland. I had the Bronx Bomber. It's a bit dissapointing because it could be really good...
The best chicken pad Thai I've had in YEARS and after eating at over a dozen different Thai restaurants. Definitely a must try.

Omg this place is so cute!!!!! Such a trendy and relaxing atmosphere with a European vibe. I ordered an amazing matcha latte that came with a paper straw ( win win for the environment ) and 2 delicious pastries. I highly recommend this adorable cafe. I can't wait to come back!!!

Spring rolls are very fresh, tom yom soup with shrimp spice level 2 was very good and shrinps were large, meaty, and perfectly cooked. Papaya salad had a strange bitter flavor which was not to my liking.  Ginger tea was very good.

We hit Penca after a Sunday matinée at the symphony. Executive Chef David Solorzano has been getting good press with revamping the menu, and this was a much anticipated visit. We arrived during happy hour, and we were presented with chips and salsa. The chips are made in-house and are literally addicting, and their salsa, although medium heat, is extremely good. 

We started with the Elote. Tender, sweet corn on the cob with chipotle aioli, queso fresco and green onions, we could've ordered another one it was so good, but we had yet to try many other offerings, so we started choosing....

Roasted Cauliflower with salsa macha and peanuts. I've had cauliflower appetizers at a number of restaurants recently, and Penca's is one of the best I've had. The difference being it wasn't deep-fried, and the salsa macha gave it an ever-so-perfect flavor. 

The Agua Chile de Callo is a raw scallop dish with chicharron dust, avocado, cucumber, and onion - set atop a squid ink sauce that changed my mind about squid ink forever! Oh my - this was heavenly. Not salty, fishy or overpowering in any way. I am now a forever fan of squid ink.

The highlight of our meal was the Pulpo - braised and grilled octopus, habanero salsa, avocado, radish, hierba de conejo black beans, pea tendrils, and Spanish chorizo. I don't have any other words than sheer delight. Don't skip any of the dishes mentioned here. They all shine.
The food is always so good! And I love that they have a variety of burgers to choose from. Even when I order from delivery services-it's always hot and fresh.

Best hot chicken in the Nashville area. Awesome boozy slush drinks. Friendly and efficient staff. Lots of tv's to watch sports. Great place for catered events with private dining. You just can not go wrong
I have been here many times .The food is fresh, plentiful and tasty with good price. The room is nice (very clean) Try this place! My favorite dish is paneer masala.
Always order the chile Colorado burrito and side of beans. The chile is always spicy and the beans are as close to homemade as possible.   A nice touch is the chips and salsa they serve on the side.

Harry's has been a mainstay all my life... It is older than me. My parents went there when they were kids, that's how old it is. You don't last this long without having something special. And this place has special food and special atmosphere and some of the help has been there since my dad was a baby. They have a great assortment of photos of all Santa Barbara all over the walls.  The drinks are stiff and the food will never disappoint.
I'm a crazy coffee snob and obsessed with a good pour over. They did amazing, if you like lighter fruitier coffee I highly recommend the Ethiopia blend. Very friendly staff as well!

I have moved to Nashville and tried several good asian like King's market has pretty good Thai food, several good Korean spots, but this place was expensive and below mediocre. I ordered $80 worth of food and my husband and I both thought it was just not good. We're Asian and eat more authentic asian food. Been to Thailand and China etc., I'm originally from Los Angeles where asian food is also top notch. 

This place is Not good. I didn't even realize Thai food could be done wrong. Basil fried rice was bad. Papaya salad was not terrible but just not like other Thai places. Pad see ew terrible. I think the general idea is that instead of authentic sauces, everything just tastes like soy sauce overkill. No nuance of what each dish should be like. 

I got the dessert Sticky rice mango and thought that was good though. I hate giving bad reviews of asian places. Usually i round up on my reviews. :( not good. Would never ever come back. There are plenty of good reviews which is why I tried it but for me and my family, it's a hard no.
Much delicious food. The servings are generous and they are made to order. Friendly staff. So far there's nothing to not like.

Stopped here with friends for a late lunch on Monday, just before our return flights. The ambience was pretty good, parking easy in the lot and staff seemed decent. We ordered 1/2 chicken and 4 chicken tenders at the counter with "hot" level and the food took about 15ish minutes. It was definitely crispy/flavorful but it did make us cry from different orifices. Being of Indian origin, we weren't expecting this heat and were quite impressed. Adding a couple of beers helped a little bit. Prices were reasonable and I took a take-away of the tenders, which surprisingly, got me pulled aside at the airport. The officer made me open the whole package to verify it wasn't something that "looks similar". I'd love to try the other places to compare with Prince's, next time I visit.

We love breakfast and as of late been real disappointed with the quality available.   Found Blueberry hill and took a chance.  The place was clean inviting.   We even had everything one comes to expect on the table.  Have been missing salt and creamer.   The food arrived quickly was hot and soooo delicious.   Can't wait to try lunch or dinner as I believe we will mot be disappointed We will come back often.
I don't know what happened to this place was great now they are all confused about orders ask for name still get orders wrong

This place has many options and the owner is absolutely sweet and very helpful! Ordered the fried egg rolls with pork and crab meat, which were delicious! The pho was good too, but I just wasn't a fan of tendon and tripe. Next time I will order a different version, but if you're into that order it because it's their best seller

Paulie is amazing! As a Chicago transplant to Tampa myself, he does our city proud! He is so personable and definitely a true sandwich artist. Every detail to his Italian beef is on point. His bread-the perfect vehicle for a moist and juicy sandwich that stays together. His giardinera- just the right amount of acid and spice to keep this comfort dish bright in the mouth. The beef alone is super tender and flavorful! One of my absolute favorite Tampa spots. And he keeps it real! So friendly and just spreading that Chicago food goodness.

So, on Saturday July 13th evening around 7ish my cousin wanted some Mexican food which I suggested a more authentic Mexican restaurant in Broad Ripple which she hasn't been before. When, my cousin and I both arrived at the restaurant around 8ish at night it was a warm humid evening & night packed on their patio, and inside had a nice crowd. The restaurant is this yellow house turned into a Mexican restaurant, with the history of the restaurant, and even art on their walls from Mexico. Everyone, was having a good time there eating, laughing, and celebrating a birthday. The restaurant is kid friendly,  decent servers, delicious margaritas that's not strong, and most importantly the prices on the menu are very affordable. For, me when it comes towards Mexican food I'm simple more like a plain Jane with food(picky eater). Anyways, I ate from the a la carte menu where I had two soft tacos with only ground beef, white shredded cheese, and sour cream. When, the Server brought me my dinner they put lettuce on it so they had to remake it. So, when I got my food again it was hot, fresh, plenty of ground beef, white shredded cheese, and sour cream. I was glad I only had two soft tacos since I was full. Also, for my drink I ordered a 16oz frozen margarita which in my opinion was just okay could had been way better. My margarita didn't have any flavor in it. Although, my very first time there I had 16oz mango margarita which was good, very fruity, not a strong alcoholic drink. Also, for t

Excellent experience! We fell upon Grillsmith after walking out of another restaurant and I'm so glad we did! The food was excellent! We had the shrimp starter, meatloaf, and pork chop marsala. It was fantastic! The shrimp was perfectly cooked and had great flavor. The pork chop and mashed cauliflower was so good my husband thought it was potatoes. It was vintage Monday so we got a bottle of wine half off and were able to take the rest home. The restaurant was clean, and service was on point. She was knowledgeable and friendly and came back to check in on us just the right amount of times and at the right time. My husband accidentally left his phone on the table which we didn't realize until after we got home a half hour away, but we called the restaurant and our server had it in the lost and found and gave it right back when we came back. Highly, highly, recommend Grillsmith!!!

My stay was overall okay in terms of location and general accommodations. One thing that influenced the mediocre rating is that they did not have complementary WiFi for their guests and charge an additional fee, like 12-15dlls/day, which I may expect from some cheap hotel but not this one, I would have probably given them 4-5 stars if not for this. The staff that I interacted with were great. The gym had everything I needed. I didn't have time to check out the pool. The hotel is connected to the convention center, which is accommodating if that's what you're coming to Philadelphia for. The market is nearby and everything is within walking distance. The train is also nearby if you need to go even further. The rooms themselves were overall okay.

Read for Covid-19 Review: 
I go to Mazzaro's every Friday. Its my favorite part of the week. Their selection of Italian goods and foods is UNMATCHED. 
They have done a great job at enforcing the mask policy. Seeing as Mazzaro's is famously bustling with people, they have made great efforts to keep it as safe as possible. The 3-4 times I have seen people without masks, the managers & employees have personally asked the customers to put on their masks. I hope that they continue to enforce this policy. 
I am rating them 4 stars, however, because they do allow people to eat at the indoor cafe at the bar. I don't think this is particularly sanitary and to me - it defeats all the good they've been doing by enforcing the mask policy! Because of this, I try to avoid the cafe section as much as possible. I hope that they will consider altering this policy.

This place is delicious! You can't leave without having their Bread Pudding French Toast! Wow! With a little glass of champagne and let's call that brunch! No line no waiting when I came here after church on a Sunday!
Delicious!!  I had the beef Yaki Udon which is beef with noodles. The taste was fantastic!
I got the adobado torts and was pleasantly surprised how good it was. Can't wait to come back and try the birria tacos on the weekend special. Super cheap food top quality.

Just moved to Indy, and of course during Covid, my furniture was delayed so I have no dishes or cooking supplies, so when I stumbled across Firebirds which had family meals, I jumped at the opportunity to order them because Hello Leftovers! 

We pretty much ate junk food on the drive up here, and I've been craving something healthy, so the deciding factor was the fact their family meals come with large salad and a large side (and they have veggie options like steamed broccoli and veggies!).

 We ordered the family grilled chicken with BLT salad (duh, bacon!), green beans, and it came with little dessert slices. The moment my husband read about the Philly egg rolls we HAD to order them, along with the key lime pie... Apparently their regular dessert sizes are large enough to feed 2-3 people, but it was so good I could demolish one by myself! 

The chicken was flame grilled and delicious and had the best juicy sauce/marinade it was floating in. We saved the tomato queso type sauce that came on the side and ended up grabbing some tortilla chips to enjoy it as a snack the next day! The green beans are fresh and crispy but soft, and cooked with sweet candied pecans... Absolutely decadent and healthy without sacrificing flavor. The BLT salad was absolutely demolished! Came with tomatoes, crispy bacon, and the most delicious garlic ranch dressing. As a New Orleanians by birth, I'm pretty sure my blood type is Garlic+ so I appreciated that! We got 3 cute little cheesecake bites and b
Great place for an excellent home cooked meal with authentic british flare! The pies are amazing and you have to try the sticky toffee pudding!
Excellent venue, excellent food! We've been to several events here and it's always a great time!

Ordered mushroom broth pho with shrimp. Huge mistake the mushroom broth smelled like paint and tasted awful.. the bao sandwich wasn't great either. Really disappointing for a Rittenhouse restaurant. Literally threw it all out. Never again.

The staff is friendly and it is clean. The meats are good. The food is way over priced for sub sandwiches.  The condiments are little. No olives, spinach to get.  One large sandwich cost over 18.00 and the bread was hard and falling apart when eating. I could have had a 6 ounce steak dinner at outback for the cost of the one sandwich that top part of bread had to be taken off. I like the meats they are good but too high priced for a sandwich. Disappointing.  I will eat there if I have a coupon for 3.00 off a sandwich.

My favorite Chinese restaurant in St. Louis.  My Chinese friends love going here and order for me.  I take pics of all the great food so I can order it again.  My only complaint- not many tables so it fills up fast. Best to get there early or do some shopping at the Chinese grocery next door.

Came here to meet some new friends, I'm ( one of those people  who counts my macros ) and they have literally all of their food nutrition facts online! 
The food was great, i had the cauliflower rice bowl with the lamb ( you can get the cauliflower bowl warm or cold ) and staff was so friendly! It's hard to find a good place with good people, and nutrition facts  
We will definitely be back again!

Worst place I've ever been. Came here with my husband and baby and waitress basically told us to leave car seat on the floor. So we left. But place smell like dirty bar inside and stuff is super non professional. So never again !!!

Not too Italian for my taste.   The first and last time we were there it's like the place was being run by a bunch of teenagers with no food service experience.   Hate giving bad reviews, but It's the truth.   Sorry.

Super friendly service but terrible whiskey. I ordered a Jack Daniels and Coca-Cola, but was handed a hot beverage that tasted like caramel. My horse did not like the taste of it either. Will not be back for whiskey. But may go back to try to get the pretty ladies number.
Horrible service. We waited over an hour to get our cold food. Cuban food? No. It was a pathetic excuse for an Americanized version of it. Oh and when the food finally came it was all messed up.

We LOVE reserving a booth and watching hockey, baseball, and football games on the giant screen. We've often said it almost beats being at the actual  event. The nachos, let me tell you about the NACHOS. They are the BEST! Large enough to feed 4 people (that's not really much of an exaggeration) and they are soooo good! Next, you cannot go wrong with the wings, mmmm. I'm a huge fan of micheladas and their spicy Bloody Mary mix paired with your favorite beer is just everything  while you're at it...get an onion ring tower!

Always good!!!!!  Ocean sauce is out of this world.  The specials are always the best.  

I love this place.  Small, intimate and just AWESOME.
The food here is great and the staff is always wonderful!! There are so many good options on the menu. You wont be disappointed.

I magically stumbled upon this wine with a friend and we simply couldn't resist the big sign outside advertising their Thursday happy hour (all night!). The deal is $20 for a bottle of Prosecco and a big platter of fries, which was perfect for two. Usually the happy hour is 5-7pm, with $5 wine, cocktails and snacks. Their wine selection is wide and the wine cellar well stocked.

We ambled in only to discover that they were also having a wine tasting that day so we hit a double whammy. The wine tasting was open to all the patrons in the bar, so we got to taste and learn about some new wine which was fun. Don't know how often they have events like that, but it seems like they do it often.

The interior is bright, cool and modern and it exudes a certain cool vibe. The service was good and friendly and we needed up having a great time! All in all it was a very good evening and a fun find!
All of the food we had was tasty and fresh.  Four of us had dinner and we all had different plates so we could try different things.  Service was great, and food was equally good.
We had the Crab Rangoon,  Fried Dumplings and combination Pho. Everything was very fresh.  Loved how everything came out so quickly. The wait staff were very nice too. Can't wait to go back.

Was in the mood for some GOOD Mexican food and heard really good things about this place so decided to give it a try. While the service was great, the food was TERRIBLE. I mean seriously, it was SO bad.
We ordered the nachos appetizer ($6) and it was very obviously microwaved. The cheese was burned to the plate and the chips were piping hot, while the sour cream and salsa on top were ice cold. We then ordered carne asada tacos ($10.95) and carnitas tacos (10.95) and oh my god - they were so bad. I took one bite and couldn't finish them. They truly tasted like something from Taco Bell that you would order at midnight. The carnitas did not taste like pork and they were covered in cheese - two things that should not go together. 
After taking one bite and deciding we were done, we were greeted with a $44 bill before we decided to go somewhere else for dinner. It was so incredibly disappointing and I will absolutely not be eating here again.

I would call my meal here wildly mediocre and my service subpar.  Was dying for a spot to eat in Fitler Square, but this didn't do it for us.  The rigatoni and meatballs sauce was missing flavor,  it was bland.  Salt helped the dish but it was so underwhelming.  The signature Cotoletta stack was good,  but that's it -  just good.  Decent flavor in it but the lack of flavor from pasta dish left us dissatisfied.  Place had a lot of patrons so I hope that they're figuring out the kinks and can get it together,  but from my experience-  not worth it.

Wow!  All the 5 star reviews are all totally accurate!  

After 8 months of eating my own cooking due to the pandemic, my girlfriend was thrilled to receive a Grubhub gift certificate as a birthday gift.  Since our favorite restaurants aren't listed on Grubhub's web site, we decided to try something new from Grubhub's restaurant list. Bayshore Mediterranean was on that list and had a high rating, so we figured we'd give them a try.

We rarely eat Mediterranean, but that's going to change as of tonight!  What fabulous flavor!  One of the reviewers said they were tempted to to lick the plate.  We ordered that same entree and have to agree.  It really is that great!  The Chicken and Lamb Shish Kabobs we also ordered were excellent, with meat still moist and flavorful despite the delivery time.
The side salad that arrived (unexpectedly) with the meal was superb!  The mix of lettuce, red onions, herbs, ingredients and dressing was a tasty delight!

We'll be back for more!
Their coffee and fresh pastries are a hit! Great brunch location that we'll be back to!

So many drink options! 

I got the soybean falafel buns (SO GOOD)
and the brisket Ramen. 
Ramen wasn't for me, though i ate most of it.. haha so hungry!
I thought the broth was too sweet. The matzo ball was good! The brisket a little tough and chewy.

I'd go back for the buns! so good...
and their great choices of japanese whiskey
also, there's a sake bar right next door! pretty cool.

Nice atmosphere, fun.

Went there over the weekend for dim sum for the first time. Food was ok..... not as good as Jumbo. 
Other than that the service was good and they spaced the tables so you are not sitting next to anyone except people you came with.

Wedding anniversary celebration. Made last minute reservations for Saturday night on Saturday afternoon. Should have recognized this red flag as all of our top choices were booked up for the night. 

I remember this place being "nice" 10-12 years ago but it felt like we were at a TGI Fridays or Chili's. Wait staff were very friendly but young and inexperienced. We were seated at a booth and the table and seats were littered with bread crumbs and who knows what else. The wall light was out and the table was very dark. The waitress messed with the bulb and it came on - for about a minute, and turned off. I messed with it, it came on for a bit and was off again (back and forth all through dinner). We must have been seated in the "Roudy" section. Very loud and foul mouthed people (many F-Bombs!) sitting either side of us. Food was okay, service was not. Waitress was really nice, apologized for the noisy neighbors, but food came and she never stopped by again except to clear the plates. Didn't bother to ask if we wanted more drinks or needed anything. Dropped the check and disappeared. Waited a long time and finally a manager (I believe - he was wearing a suit) took the check.

We almost left after getting drinks and regret that we didn't. We have a dinner reservation this week at a "good" restaurant to re-celebrate our anniversary. We hope to replace this bad memory with a positive one of our anniversary celebration.

We were in the area for a wedding and visited The Hattery for brunch the morning after. Attached to a very cute hotel, the decor is very cool. Vintage suitcases line one of the walls in the lobby, and the basement has an impressive artistic tree that spans two floors. The restaurant was not too busy, probably because rolled in pretty early. 

Our group started with the deviled eggs, which were made with a dijon mustard sauce and absolutely delicious. I ordered the chicken and waffles for my entree, which was very good. I could tell that the chicken was perfectly crispy when it came out of the fryer, but the side that was covered in sausage gravy definitely was soggy. It would've been great to enjoy that more of that crispy crunch. I also would've liked a little more kick somewhere in this dish, so I added it myself with some hot sauce. I believe that everyone at my table also enjoyed their dishes. 

Additionally, we thought the service was good. She took care of everything we needed and was happy to give recommendations. 

Overall, we really enjoyed our breakfast here! This was a great spot in a cute town - definitely stop by if you're in the area!

I have to openly admit that I actually enjoy Chipotle. It's just so inconsistent and location really does matter. Before this one opened I would often go to the one on the Blvd. The Neshaminy one I completely avoid at all costs. 

This is a new store so they get some leeway. The staff is what it is. They're not the friendliest and they're overworked. I'm a sucker for the new carne asada. Unfortunately, both times I went they were out. Not sure how or why but they were. They lose a star just for that. I ordered 3 tacos to go. I hate the way they pack them. Just in foil? They were cracked and soggy by the time I got home. I was literally eating a bowl that wasn't a bowl. The toppings were also just thrown on. The guacamole, sour cream and cheese were stuck to the foil. Kinda sucked.. 


The restaurant itself is very clean and seem larger than most others. I will reluctantly go back for my taco fix.

This was our first stay at this resort.  The views of the mountains are just stunning, the rooms were clean and they allow small dogs with a deposit of $50.00 each non-refundable.  Ok, I get that.  There were 4 adults, 1 child and 2 small dogs in our party and it cost almost $600.00 for one night.  The beds were comfortable and the pools were beautiful!  We had to walk I don't know how long, to get to our Casita, and the walking area to get there was sloped all the way which made it very uncomfortable to walk back and forth to your car. (about 1/4 -1/2 mile) It was sloped left to right.  It cost $11.00 for a valet. Check in is at 4 pm (they were very strict about that), check out is 11 am sharp.  Good grief!  We were charged $30.00 for a late checkout for 2pm and $15.00 per hour for anytime after that.  There is also a $25.00 resort charge if you use a 3rd party.  Room service would had been expensive if we would had used it...$3.50 for delivery and 21% tip for the waiter plus the expensive food.  The rooms were comparable to a little bit bigger than a standard Holiday Inn.  The Casitas do not have a fenced in area for pets and again, you are fighting the sloped area outside.  Parking was very limited, the spaces were tiny and it was really hard to park.  Our family made the most of this.  This was a surprise for our granddaughter to go see the Biosphere (why we wanted the later check out time) We were very disappointed though.  We have stayed at very nice hotels/resorts befo

We tried the ribs, brisket and pulled pork. It was all delicious, but the brisket was probably the best I've ever had. We had a slice of the sweet potato pie at the end which was also great! Will definitely be coming back.

The best Chinese hands down! The hot n sour soup is phenomenal!!! The general tso chicken, crab ragoon and hibachi is all insanely good! We eat here a lot for take out and dine in and they always get it right! Everything is always fresh and piping hot!!

If you were looking for heavenly food then look no further. This is classic Italian foods look no further. Pasta meats sauces gravy's  and sandwiches they are all here. Love to stop on the way home and pick up dinner so fresh and food.

Came for the chicken sandwich in the middle of the chicken sandwich wars. My sandwich was way overcooked and the cabbage was cut too big and was too hard to chew I actually threw the sandwich away. The fries though are excellent, perfectly fried crisp, natural cut with the skin on. Loved the fries hate the chicken sandwich stick with the burger.
Food is expensive & menu is fancy but....food is good! More of a girls night out dinner than a family dinner.

Not impressed!!!! I had been wanting to try this place forever. Since we had business at lAkelawn /Metairie we stopped here for breakfast.  We waited at our table for at least 15 mins before hubby asked the lady cleaning  a nearby table to get our server. We were ready to order as soon as he finally came to the table. Food came out quickly & was lukewarm. Hubby ordered the eggs Benedict duo of the pulled pork & chicken st Charles. I ordered the white chocolate bread pudding pancakes. They were 2 big pancakes with abt 5 white chocolate chips on top & a drizzle of some kind of white sauce on top. All I could taste was a doughy, floury taste. No white chocolate bread pudding taste here!! Hubby did like the pulled pork Benedict. So disappointed, I was excited to try it here. I don't think we will back.
Happened twice so far. Was served non-vegetarian (chicken) sandwich in the place of a vegetarian option after specifically mentioning that I want a falafel (vegetarian) sandwich.

I ordered the strawberry walnut feta salad with chicken. There was no walnuts, they didn't have vinaigrette so they tossed in ranch. Yuck! And the chicken was shredded and seasoned for tacos. They were out of plastic bags. They just opened up and need some serious work. Won't be going there again.

Wow where to start, this was my second visit, we came here yesterday. We had spaghetti with meat sauce yesterday and was so delicious!!! The place is so very good we brought back my daughter and 2 of my granddaughters. No one was disappointed the food is outstanding and fresh!!! That lemon chicken soup it was so delicious I smelled it as it was brought up!!!! I tasted a little of everything here and I must say everything was amazing!!! They have lots of room in the booths you can sit 4 adults and two children per booth. Also has plenty of room between seat and table to fill your tummy up!!!! Yes the food is that doggone good!!!! It's worth 35 minutes drive and a 20 minute wait to be seated. I really didn't have to wait if we wanted to sit outside under the roof with ceiling fans. I just wanted the grandchildren to enjoy the sites and decorations on the walls. It's worth waiting for 20-30 minutes yes the food is really that delicious!!!

I apologize, but this is just bad pizza. Tastes likes a frozen pizza, undercooked, cheese would slide all the way off every slice. Bland and flavorless. Could not and would not recommend to anyone who is familiar with good pizza..

Wanted to dine in somewhere since I am visiting out of town and trying to help get my niece and nephew out of the house so my sister and brother in law can do work uninterrupted.... our first choice place was only doing take out and my sister suggested we try chariot... WAS NOT DISAPPOINTED! The pizza was absolutely delicious and the bread sticks were such a great soft and crispy unique texture! My husband really loved the hot wings, he said they had a great flavor and were hot! It was nice we were able to order a pizza and split the toppings too! Definitely suggest eating here!

Food is excellent, so many choices and the staff is super pleasant. I got breakfast a couple
Of times and lunch to go. Such a cute little place. Not sure why anyone give it less than 5 stars. Also, coffee is very good.

Don't make a big order
it will be wrong..lol
my order is never right!
and the one  young 
spanish  gal 
who speaks English,
is very snippy.&rude
sorry CREW
the food is decent.
Tty the Mexican rest on Main Street 
in Norristown.
nice people great food.

YOOOO i just got take out sushi from this place and it is unbelievable. fresh, crisp and amazing. my husband got chicken katsu(crispy and juiceyyyy) and a HUGE portion of pork fried rice which i am excited to steal some later. THANK YOU! i'm so excited to find a great place!!

Wish I could leave a better review and knew why this establishment was ran so poorly tonight. Waitress was nice the 2/3 time we saw her and the food and drink was great but it felt like a hassle to order more or even the check.

AVOID AT ALL COST !!! Service is Horrible !!!
I walked in with my family and immediately I noticed the place is a run down dump. We walked in and the first person to see us was at the bar and he just pointed us to a table. We sat ourselves, the table was filthy and sticky. the first waitress asked us for drinks and told the second waitress to give us menus in which she threw the menus, utensils, napkins at me and scattered all over my table. I felt so disrespected I just took my family and left. I DO NOT RECOMMEND !!!. If I can give this place a zero star I would. HORRIBLE SERVICE !!!. I will never come back.

We had an awful experience on Christmas Eve. I had ordered our Christmas Eve carry out dinner online around 5:45pm, paid for it, and was told I could pick up the meal at 7:01pm. When I arrived at the restaurant, I entered the carry out line that was crowded with people. (If I contract COVID, this is probably where it happened.) When I finally got to talk to someone around 7:15, I was told that it might by "an hour or two" before our food came out. I asked for a refund. I was given no explanation about why they could not fill the order.

The first time I went here everything was great. The Naan was perfect and so was their butter chicken. I went back last week and it was still delicious. If you are in the area and want some great Indian food, go to Guru's

Finally had a chance to try Ocean Blue. I wanted to make a reservation, but no one ever answered the phone. I was a little doubtful about what I would encounter and was very happy I still decided to go. The restaurant is huge so a reservation wasn't necessary. (I guess that's why they don't answer the phone, though I did see takeout but maybe they answer later in the day). Now, the important stuff. 

The Sapporo was really cold. I'm not a saki fan, but they did have a nice selection.  They also had a full bar and a large selection of beer.

Tried the shrimp shumai and it was a little on the tasteless side. I used to order it quite often when I lived in NY and it was not as good as I remember from then. However, the super protein roll was delicious with beautifully fresh fish. The same with the yellow tail sashimi. It almost melted in my mouth. 

The only disappointment was we ordered the vegetable roll off the sushi menu but asked that it be made with cucumber instead of rice. As with Beachwood, the cucumber was way too thick. Also, they upcharged us $4 for switching out the cucumber for rice so I would be careful if you want to do that with any other rolls.

Hands down the best Mediterranean food that I have ever had. We have eaten in the restaurant but mostly do take out because it's small. I have to say  we are never disappointed. The meats are so full of flavor and the homemade pita bread and hummus are to die for. Love this place
Was looking for good take out and wasn't disappointed with this place! Got the tofu Pad Se Ew and a few others. All great, will definitely order from here again!

Not safe. If I could give this a negative amount of stars, I could. I've had a chance to see the back of the house, and it's horrific. Both raw and cooked meat is left out for long periods of time and cooked at dangerously low temperatures. They're cooked on top of one another so the nastiness drips down to the rest of the meat. They cook their chickens by wrapping them in plastic wrap, freezing them, then microwaving them again. Yes the plastic does get stuck on the meat. Yes you will be eating toxic residue, along with a massive culture of ecoli and salmonella. I sincerely hope this place closes down, but I know it won't. Something must be wrong with the health inspector.

I came here for the first time with some coworkers for lunch today.  I really liked the vibe, layout and decor!  They must have spent a fortune on decorating.  Instead of an entree, I ordered 2 appetizers: local goat cheese fondue and thick cut candied bacon.  The bacon was soooo good, my coworkers were jealous lol.  Would definitely order again! The fondue was good (I've never met a cheese I didn't like) but I thought it was a little pricey for the amount of fondue that was served.  Due to there being 7 of us, we had to sit at a table instead of a booth.  The chairs were very uncomfortable: the back of the chairs are very oddly shaped and unless you are a size zero or a child, they will give you problems.  All in all, I will definitely be returning but will opt for a booth next time :)

So,... My two daughters and I are going to visit family in Chester, Pa. We arrive the night before and wanted to go somewhere near where we were staying for the evening. I remember two years since I visited Michael's sandwich shop in Woodlyn, Pa and I received the amazing hospitality, service not to mention melt in your mouth Chesse steak hoagie and cheese fries. Surprisingly I come in and order a hoagie and fries like last time just to see Anna again with a reserved and welcoming smile who says something like I remember you... Al!  Truly heartfelt. So of course my daughters and I get back to our hotel and get down on this amazing comfort food and one again the taste brought me back to the great cheese steak hoagie I had two years ago. Delicious! So what do we do with this repeated experience? The next day en route to leaving for home we stop by Michael's for food to go. Yum. Stop by. A short distance off of I476 and I95.

Mother's Day placed order around 530 for Mother's Day meal. We were told it would take at least an hour to 90 minutes we had called back again and we were told that by a driver that we're going to get it out to you as soon as possible . This is a big edit later I found out it was DoorDash that pulled out of line. I had come up to the outback on 60 and to find why and talk to a manager and the customer service was outstanding so it was not Outback's fault at all and I do apologize that this posted I thought I edited it. I went back the next day to place an order and everything went smoothly to make up for Mother's Day fiasco. So now  My wife loves me again  We will from Order for Outback again and door dash is done in our house.

Just relocated from South Florida my first time ordering for delivery through Door Dash from Beyond Bread . I ordered Carmela's Caprese  on a Giabatta . It was absolutely the best of the best. I can't find the words ten STARS for sure!  Don't hesitate. Everything from the easy scrumptious menu to the ease of delivery right on time requested it's a WIN/ WIN! Love Love This Place. I am addicted!

I should have known from the mildew smell when you first walk in to turn around and pick a different location. The food was horrible. I ordered a salmon salad and the salmon was rubber and clearly processed.The oatmeal was also disgusting and dry. When we told the waiter about the horrible food she explained that in fact it was processed fish. When we expressed our disappointment and that we would not be returning, we were told " that's okay".....  As a business owner myself , I was shocked to hear and experience this service. Cute location, sad that the exterior doesn't match the food or service.

I don't ever write reviews, but man everything was soooo delicious! The vegan knots (garlic and maple) were AMAZING! And their cashew sauce on the vegan options are so yummy! We added the vegan pepperoni to the baba (which was incredible) and vegan sausage to the mushroom one ! We were very happy with our dinner choice!

Ordered a vegan vanilla cake with vegan buttercream for my sisters birthday and it was perfect!! It tasted just as good if not better than a regular cake. 

I sent Puffy Muffin a photo of what I wanted and it was literally spot on. I was so impressed! Vegan cake was a little pricier than normal cakes but honestly it was so worth it. Thanks!!

We ordered this pizza via delivery last night.  We ordered two pizzas.  They arrived very timely and the pizza was still very hot.  The delivery person was very nice.  We all enjoyed this pizza.  My mother commented that the bottom crust was cooked to perfection.  It was nice and crispy without being overdone.  The toppings were really tasty.  I would definitely order this pizza again.

My husband and I were in last week, and While we had good food, and the service was fine our entire group was extremely disappointed. We brought our son in for his third birthday which just so happens to also be Halloween. We all thought that such a kid friendly place   that offers giant milk shakes and a candy store he would be offered some sort of special treat for his birthday. I'm not mad by any means, but just want to make a suggestion. If you are establishing yourselves as a whimsical, kid friendly place you should probably do something special for guests that come in on their birthdays especially children.  Even the local Mexican restaurants give out a free scoop of ice cream on birthdays.

La petite was so yummy! Super unique food in New Orleans with French flair. Tried the pierogi's, apple salad, blue crab beignets, ricotta dumplings, and the shrimp and grits! Everything was so fresh and had distinctive flavor profiles...
Ended with the lemon pound cake!

We found this place browsing on Yelp and it had great reviews. We decided to give it a try and site was AMAZING!!! Everythinv on the menu sounded good and looking at all of the fresh cuts of meat made it hard to choose because I wanted to try everything. The food was fresh, delicious and came out quickly!!!
Wow if you wanna go into a fairy tale, this place is magical. The experience is truly sublime. The food and pastries are incredibly subpar, but the experience and the drinks are good

I didn't get to eat here, but I feel like they have earned a review.  I made careful plans to get to Campo's before they closed, so that I could pick up a sandwich before I want to a game night with friends.  

They decided to close 15 minutes early.  The person picking up the rug reacted like I was the bad guy for wondering why they weren't keeping their hours.  I'll never go to this place.  That's what happens, Campo's, when you aren't faithful to your hours.

There are plenty of other places in town to get a Philly cheesesteak, even for lactose and gluten intolerant people.

Both of their drive thru lanes were open and so I went to the next drive thru lane where someone ordered before me. I sat there and waited for them to take more order...2 mins pass no response. The car in the other drive thru pulls forward...4 mins pass still nothing on my side and another car pulls forward. This time i ask if anyone can hear me in the microphone and no reply. I wait another 3 mins and another car on the other side pull thru. At this time I've waited about 10 mins an no response. WILL NEVER GO HERE AGAIN! TERRIBLE SERVICE!
Not too bad, but not the best either. The pho is disappointing and I've tried a few times. It's the closest Thai place around, so it works when you just gotta have Thai!

1 star only because the Food was delicious! Waitress needs some customer service training. No greetings. We sat with an empty bowl of chips, ended up grabbing a bowl from a vacant table. She never once asked how we're doing or how our meal was. My mom was charged $3.00 for a side of sour cream. I was hoping the cashier would at least care and ask about our meal was.....But nope, just as rude as the waitress. There's to many other good Mexican food places in Tucson to ever go there a again and get treated that way.

It's been a month or so since we were at Oregano's.  To my dismay, they removed my favorite item from their menu!!  I love all of their food, but we try to eat low carb, so a lot of their items don't fit the low carb diet.  My favorite thing to order there was their Brussels sprouts!  My mouth is watering just thinking about them!  They always took a little longer to make, and their staff always warned me of this, but it was always definitely worth the wait!  They were that good!  But, alas, no more!!  We always sat at the bar, and I can't tell you how many times people at the bar would look at them and tell me they looked good.  Many times I offered to let them taste one, and they always loved them!  If you ever revamp your menu, please, please, Oregano's, bring back your Brussels sprouts!!

Yikes what an unexpected experience today. I've been here 10+times over the past year, and few things really stood out today. 
1. Rude and unprofessional staff
2. A lot of items now cost extra, when previously the only up-charge was Avocado. Those now include: crab, masago, and a few other items I can't recall.
The staff expected I knew about these new charges when I asked for them, and got a bit angry when I didn't. 

I'm a bit surprised, and I don't think I'll be back. 

Just paid $30 for two pretty average bowls. That's a bit disappointing.

I miss their food. My wife and I used to go every morning but due to my schedule I haven't been able to go there, for now. Grits and corned beef hash was my favorite and the owner was very friendly. The staff as well, we miss them.

Classic restaurant right off of Bourbon.   White tableclothes, etc
Service was good.  There seems to be an unenforced dress code.  

Had the seafood gumbo to start.  Decent portion.  Nice flavor.
Redfish to finish.  Good cajun cuisine.  Overall, a decent meal.

The restaurant is a little loud so be warned.   But what would you expect, its on Bourbon Street.

Why does this place have only 3.5 stars?? Oh-ma-God.. the food was incredible. Craft cocktails were so unique and delicious, plus friendly & quick service (our server was Kayla S.) Win, win, win. Come on ya'll!!

First of all, my meal today was a 1 star  My burger was SO overcooked,  it was like hard leather. The bacon was very undercooked and fatty. I didn't even eat half and threw it out. I wish they would ask us how we woukd like our burger cooked because half the time I forget to say medium rare. However,  usually it is cooked perfect and moist. My partner's burger was supposed to be a regular hamburger.  No cheese. He is lactose intolerant.  He couldn't eat it. Beside portions of the burger were burned. He threw his out, without a bite. That being said, the reason I gave 5 stars is because usually my food is top notch. This is actually the first time getting something so terrible. I usually have no issue spending money here because it is do good. But today $25 for a meal was not worth a single penny. Hopefully this is a total fluke because I will be bummed to have to find another burger joint.

Always around this area for work. Food LOOKS great. Service was good. Never got my food. Waited 45 mins. Really hate to say it. Really want to give this place a chance but only get 30 mins for lunch. Better luck next time I guess. Love going back to work hungrier than when I left.

MY FAVORITE Greek restaurant in Tampa!! The gyros are to die for. And the size of them is so much bigger than other places, it will actually fill you up. Really hard to find good, authentic Greek.... and this is definitely a needle in a haystack! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Gross and low-budget. The hot pot was no bueno, frozen meats, unappetizing and inconsistent sides, and questionable seafood.

We ordered delivery pizza for our office on Benjamin Road.   It arrived on time and was hot and delicious.  The ingredients were all so fresh and it was one of the best pizzas I have eaten in some time.   We will definitely be ordering from this establishment again.  The delivery driver was very friendly and our order was exactly as expected.

Great pizza. Hands down! Go there after midnight and be prepared to brawl. The drunks are out and they WILL skip the line. Whomever they payoff allows these types of behaviors. Totally unacceptable! The "security" is a joke. Definitely there to detour the drunks. All in all, go during the day unless you're prepared to deal with shenanigans. Sorry Joey!

They are delivering right now! My usual place was not. So I thought I would change it up, my original Chinese spot I've been eating at for the past 20 years seems to be steading declining across the board. The guy who answered was super nice! The total bill was cheaper than my normal place and I ordered more food! The food was good. The chicken lo mein was a little bland but everything else was amazing! The sweet and sour chicken was great and the beef and broccoli was good! No fortune cookies but that's ok! I will order again.

Okay so you would think this spot is awesome based on its location and how they market themselves but it is bland. The review regarding how bland the food is dead on. 

The food looks really good (see picture) and the staff is very friendly and nice but the meat is not flavorful. 

I'm not quite sure what it is - maybe it is a lack of cooking time or seasoning? But even when I have made ribs at home with just salt and pepper they tasted better 

This would be a great place to introduce young kids to bbq since the tastes won't over power them. 

If you are starving and can't go anywhere else then go here

Arrived to get my order and was asked phone number and name... told it would be 10 min more.... waited more than 15min and was asked the same questions.... waited another 20 min ...  another associate asked the same questions... I'm normally a very patient person, but at this point I would have just left, but I paid online.... I ordered over an hour and a half ago... pick up time was an hour ago.... I would wait to finish this feedback after I actually get my order, but my phone is at 3%

Good tasting food, but wow, they've gotten VERY stingy on their portions... I used to hype this place up to all my friends that come into town and that live in ATL, but I probably won't be back. The fish taco had the smallest piece of fish on it I've ever seen. Come on y'all...

The best reuben in town, and for so cheap! Pickle's is a cute deli and everyone working there is very nice. I ordered a sandwich for pickup but got held up at work so I was almost an hour late to pick it up, and they made me a new sandwich and a fresh bowl of soup. The place is always clean, the food is cheap, filling, and delicious, and the atmosphere is very welcoming.

Have to say, meets up with the hype and reviews.

Had the Pig Mac and Some BBQ Ribs. Started off with some Duck Pastrami. All nicely prepared and tasted great.

Seating can be a bit better. But suits the decore ok. Staff and service was good.

Recommen...
Nailed it. Excellent atmosphere and stellar food.   We are In Nashville for a conference and just has to stop by. Their Instagram is just fun.  We had a great time. Thanks

I've given this place a couple tries but their food is just not very good unfortunately. They do have reasonable prices and are very friendly but that can only go so far when the food quality is lacking.

Very solid and reliable. I've probably spent close to $1,000 here in the past year... almost entirely  on yellowtail, spicy tuna, and white tuna rolls, including as takeout during Covid. I was recently disappointed to see their low sanitation score and violations on Yelp and questioned whether I should go back... but I reminded myself how much I've had their sushi over the past year with no issues (*knock on wood as I consume my raw fish*). Since covid I've consistently seen the staff wear masks over their nose and mouth and find them to be better value than the other nearby sushi options esp with their sushi roll lunch special, and comparable if not better quality.

My husband and I love Indian food and stopped in for lunch yesterday since we were in the area for an obligation. We had read a lot of positive reviews on here and were excited to dig in to our food. It did not disappoint!! We ordered Gobi Manchurian, Chicken Tikka Masala, Paneer Vindaloo, Garlic Naan, and a Mango Lassi. Every component was so amazing!! We could not stop eating the Gobi Machurian - crispy batter and perfect sauce! Loved it! The entrees (chicken tikka and paneet vindaloo) were also delectable. Yumm... Just an All around great meal. Did I mention the portions were huge - I'll definitely get a second, if not third, meal out of my entree. The hubs got 2 meals out of his.

Oh - can't forget that the attentiveness gentleman working the front counter. He even gave us complimentary 3-pieces of gulab jamun - and it warm and just divine!! 

This is a new favorite spot for us. We will definitely be back!!

The bbq cauliflower was scrumptious!!!!!! It was my favorite side dishes. I will definitely recommend this to my family when they try this restaurant. The greens and jambalaya was also pretty good. Now, keep in mind, this meal is vegan, so it won't taste EXACTLY how your grandma made it, but it's still tasty and made with love! 

Also, do yourself a favor and ordered the soursop!!! Five stars!!!!! You will love it even if you are not a big fan of ginger!

I'm a big fan of this place. I've been on multiple occasions and the food is always good and consistent. Yes, it is a hotel restaurant, but you wouldn't be able to tell. It's connected to the Indianapolis Marriott downtown but has its own separate entrance and regularly draws a crowd independent of its hotel guests for both brunch and dinner. On warmer days there are fire pits on the patio with nice seating and good people watching. They are also dog-friendly. National Margarita day featured $2 blood orange margaritas that were awesome! 
Must try: crab hushpuppies, cornbread app, smoked wings. I'm also a big fan of their salads (try the kale!)
